Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Jute Area Rug, 3 x 5 Foot, Nuetral Multicolor
Materials: stone
Upgrade your home decor with this striking modern-style rug. Its bold shapes provide a focal point for your room, and its strong but neutral colors are sure to both complement and enhance your existing interior-design theme. 3' x 5' 100% jute Natural jute fibers give this rug a rustic feel. It is handcrafted by Craftmark-certified artisans, helping to preserve the global craft tradition. Flatweave (pile is not applicable) Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
